## Architectural Philosophy
Moses Thomas prioritizes production readiness, measurable performance, and verifiable engineering over conceptual prototypes. Every system is built around:
1. Strict type-safety with TypeScript and Python.
2. Grounded AI models that mandate source citations and prevent hallucinations (RAG).
3. Sub-second initial paints and resilient edge caching.
4. Clean ownership transfer with audited repositories, Docker setups, and continuous integration workflows.
